pre_metric_nonstandard_fixture_adjudicat.policy: a fixture that did not reach a normal competitive full-time result and was resolved administratively is not assigned a synthetic FT score; an authoritative pre-metric frozen exception may reduce expected scored-result rows by one exact directed fixture

lower_tier_result_history.source: Football-Data.co.uk via immutable GitHub transport mirror
lower_tier_result_history.content_binding: all 25 mirror files are frozen by exact path, Git blob and byte count in the pre-metric transport mirror receipt; runtime verifies binding before parsing and records raw plus converted SHA256
lower_tier_result_history.scored_result_completeness_rule: for every competition-season all five required result fields must be non-empty and directed scored home-away pairs unique; expected scored rows equal n*(n-1) minus only the exact pre-metric frozen authoritative nonstandard omissions; every omission pair must be absent from the scored rows and no synthetic score may be inserted
lower_tier_result_history.conversion_rule: deterministically strip the original Football-Data CSV to Date/HomeTeam/AwayTeam/FTHG/FTAG only before the unchanged preregistered evaluator consumes it
lower_tier_result_history.identity_rule: no transport/source-specific team aliases and no fuzzy matching; evaluator uses existing repository deterministic canonical/global-team-id machinery and fails on missing or ambiguous identity
